goal: Allow node operators to obfuscate, rotate keys, or deobfuscate existing block and undo files without resyncing
Prevent antivirus scanners from misidentifying raw block payloads and corrupting older node storage
agreement: Concept support for exposing reobfuscation functionality (stickies-v, sedited)
Support with migration logic approved after parsing and error handling fixes (sedited)
Concerns on file chunking, timestamps, and pruned nodes resolved (ajtowns)
Nonblocking objection: prefer a standalone utility over daemon startup migration logic (stickies-v, luke-jr)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because protects legacy-synced nodes against antivirus corruption without redownloading the chain
Adds safe resumable file migration but is an operational maintenance feature rather than an urgent bug fix
